items.informal_name: Lower Bound for Polynomial Evaluation at Rational Points
items.type:
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {a b : ℤ},
  0 < b →
    Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f) ≠ 0 →
      1 ≤ ↑b ^ f.natDegree * |Polynomial.eval (↑a / ↑b) (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ K) f)|
items.informal_description: For any linearly ordered field $ K $ with strict ordered ring structure, given a non-zero polynomial $ f \in \mathbb{Z}[X] $, integers $ a, b $ with $ b > 0 $, and assuming $ f\left(\frac{a}{b}\right) \neq 0 $, it holds that $ 1 \leq b^{\deg(f)} \cdot \left| f\left(\frac{a}{b}\right) \right| $, where $ \deg(f) $ denotes the natural degree of $ f $.

items.informal_name: Liouville's Approximation Theorem for Irrational Roots of Integer Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {α : ℝ},
  Irrational α →
    ∀ {f : Polynomial ℤ},
      f ≠ 0 →
        Polynomial.eval α (Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℤ ℝ) f) = 0 →
          ∃ A, 0 < A ∧ ∀ (a : ℤ) (b : ℕ), 1 ≤ (↑b + 1) ^ f.natDegree * (|α - ↑a / (↑b + 1)| * A)
items.informal_description: Let $\alpha$ be an irrational real number and let $f \in \mathbb{Z}[X]$ be a non-zero polynomial such that $f(\alpha) = 0$. Then there exists a positive real number $A$ such that for all integers $a$ and natural numbers $b$, the inequality $1 \leq A \cdot (b + 1)^{\deg(f)} \cdot |\alpha - \frac{a}{b + 1}|$ holds.

items.informal_name: Lindemann-Weierstrass Polynomial Approximation for Exponentials of Algebraic Numbers
items.type:
∀ (f : Polynomial ℤ),
  Polynomial.eval 0 f ≠ 0 →
    ∃ c,
      ∀ p > (Polynomial.eval 0 f).natAbs,
        Nat.Prime p →
          ∃ n,
            ¬↑p ∣ n ∧
              ∃ gp,
                gp.natDegree ≤ p * f.natDegree - 1 ∧
                  ∀ {r : ℂ},
                    r ∈ f.aroots ℂ → ‖n • Complex.exp r - p • (Polynomial.aeval r) gp‖ ≤ c ^ p / ↑(p - 1).factorial
items.informal_description: For any non-zero constant term polynomial $ f \in \mathbb{Z}[X] $, there exists a constant $ c > 0 $ such that for all primes $ p > |f(0)| $, there exists an integer $ n \not\equiv 0 \mod p $ and a polynomial $ g_p \in \mathbb{Z}[X] $ of degree $ \leq p \cdot \deg(f) - 1 $ satisfying: for every complex root $ r $ of $ f $, the inequality $ \|n \cdot e^r - p \cdot \operatorname{aeval}(r, g_p)\| \leq \frac{c^p}{(p-1)!} $ holds, where $ \operatorname{aeval} $ denotes polynomial evaluation in the algebraic structure and $ \|\cdot\| $ is the complex norm.

items.informal_name: Existence of Polynomial Partition with Degree Condition
items.type:
∀ {Fq : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Fq] [inst_1 : Field Fq] (n : ℕ) {ε : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    ∀ {b : Polynomial Fq},
      b ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (A : Fin n → Polynomial Fq),
          ∃ t,
            ∀ (i₀ i₁ : Fin n),
              t i₀ = t i₁ ↔ ↑(Polynomial.cardPowDegree (A i₁ % b - A i₀ % b)) < Polynomial.cardPowDegree b • ε
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$, positive real $\varepsilon$, non-zero polynomial $b \in \mathbb{F}_q[X]$, and function $A : \mathrm{Fin}(n) \to \mathbb{F}_q[X]$, there exists a function $t : \mathrm{Fin}(n) \to \mathrm{Fin}(\#\mathbb{F}_q^{\lceil -\log \varepsilon / \log \#\mathbb{F}_q \rceil})$ such that for all $i_0, i_1 \in \mathrm{Fin}(n)$, $t(i_0) = t(i_1)$ if and only if $\deg(A(i_1) \bmod b - A(i_0) \bmod b) < \deg(b) \cdot \varepsilon$.

items.informal_name: Approximation of Polynomials over Finite Fields via Modulo Operations
items.type:
∀ {Fq : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Fq] [inst_1 : Field Fq] {b : Polynomial Fq},
  b ≠ 0 →
    ∀ {ε : ℝ},
      0 < ε →
        ∀ (A : Fin (Fintype.card Fq ^ ⌈-Real.log ε / Real.log ↑(Fintype.card Fq)⌉₊).succ → Polynomial Fq),
          ∃ i₀ i₁, i₀ ≠ i₁ ∧ ↑(Polynomial.cardPowDegree (A i₁ % b - A i₀ % b)) < Polynomial.cardPowDegree b • ε
items.informal_description: For any non-zero polynomial $ b $ over a finite field $ \mathbb{F}_q $ and any $ \varepsilon > 0 $, if $ A $ is a family of polynomials indexed by a finite set of size $ q^{\lceil -\log \varepsilon / \log q \rceil} $, then there exist distinct indices $ i_0, i_1 $ such that the $ \mathbb{F}_q $-cardinality-degree norm of $ (A(i_1) \bmod b - A(i_0) \bmod b) $ is less than $ \varepsilon \cdot q^{\deg b} $. Here, the cardinality-degree norm $ \text{cardPowDegree}(p) $ of a polynomial $ p $ is defined as $ q^{\deg p} $.

items.informal_name: Existence of Polynomial Pairs with Bounded Degree Difference
items.type:
∀ {Fq : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Fq] [inst_1 : Ring Fq] {d m : ℕ},
  Fintype.card Fq ^ d ≤ m →
    ∀ (b : Polynomial Fq) (A : Fin m.succ → Polynomial Fq),
      (∀ (i : Fin m.succ), (A i).degree < b.degree) → ∃ i₀ i₁, i₀ ≠ i₁ ∧ (A i₁ - A i₀).degree < ↑(b.natDegree - d)
items.informal_description: Given a finite ring $ Fq $ with cardinality $ q $, natural numbers $ d $ and $ m $ such that $ q^d \leq m $, a nonzero polynomial $ b \in Fq[X] $, and a function $ A: \mathrm{Fin}(m+1) \to Fq[X] $ where each $ A(i) $ has degree less than $ \deg(b) $, there exist distinct indices $ i_0, i_1 \in \mathrm{Fin}(m+1) $ such that the degree of $ A(i_1) - A(i_0) $ satisfies $ \deg(A(i_1) - A(i_0)) < \mathrm{natdeg}(b) - d $, where $ \mathrm{natdeg}(b) $ denotes the natural degree of $ b $ (equal to $ \deg(b) $ if nonzero, otherwise 0).

items.informal_name: Numerical Bound for Multivariate Polynomials in Chevalley's Theorem
items.informal_description: A function that takes a natural number $n$, a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, and another natural number $m$, returning a natural number used to establish well-founded recursion in the context of multivariate polynomials and Chevalley's theorem. It computes bounds by recursively applying $f$ to $n$ and decrementing $m$.

items.informal_name: Partitioning Polynomials with Bounded Differences Modulo a Non-Zero Polynomial
items.type:
∀ {Fq : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Fq] [inst_1 : Field Fq] (n : ℕ) {ε : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    ∀ {b : Polynomial Fq},
      b ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (A : Fin n → Polynomial Fq),
          ∃ t,
            ∀ (i₀ i₁ : Fin n),
              t i₀ = t i₁ → ↑(Polynomial.cardPowDegree (A i₁ % b - A i₀ % b)) < Polynomial.cardPowDegree b • ε
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$, positive real number $\varepsilon$, non-zero polynomial $b \in \mathbb{F}_q[X]$, and sequence of $n$ polynomials $A_0, \ldots, A_{n-1} \in \mathbb{F}_q[X]$, there exists a partition function $t$ mapping indices $\{0, \ldots, n-1\}$ to $\left\lceil \frac{-\log \varepsilon}{\log |\mathbb{F}_q|} \right\rceil$ classes such that for any two indices $i_0, i_1$ in the same class, the difference $A_{i_1} \mod b - A_{i_0} \mod b$ has $\text{cardPowDegree}$ strictly less than $\varepsilon \cdot \text{cardPowDegree}(b)$. Here, $\text{cardPowDegree}$ denotes a degree-like measure combining field cardinality and polynomial degree, and $|\mathbb{F}_q|$ is the size of the finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$.
